title: Consume European Firaga linked transfer sources
changes: Extend existing row and descriptor resources with the authenticated Firaga transfer pair, preserving the shared wrapper, compressed stream, earlier representations and guest fallback.
validation: Wine reader e357-firaga-linked-transfer-readers-wine-be8l1_ah verifies six original interpreter/generated cases, 144 unchanged resources, shared ownership, authentication, boundaries and snapshot ownership.
Wine scene e357-firaga-linked-transfer-scene-wine-izp2e4pq consumes both sources across 606 altered-source frames while state, guest clock, video, OAM, dispatch and five audio streams match.

Wine CLI e357-firaga-linked-transfer-cli-wine-6dug_n2c creates, reuses and verifies 147 matching files; static join e357-firaga-linked-transfer-sample-residual-ah1pd9hx leaves nine unowned addresses in the E302 sample.
limitations: The address-only sample does not establish individual PCs or prove the conditional pointer ancestry. Other indices, callers, scenes, source-save history, real BIOS and UI save/Load remain open.
Older revision-sensitive Wine fixtures need adaptation and rerun; Linux, USA and native Windows remain pending. No performance comparison was made.
